name: Waldfrieden
beschreibung:
Overview

The Ferienhaus Waldfrieden is located at Kartitsch 157 in the Neuwinkl district of the East Tyrolean municipality of Kartitsch (9941). The house is idyllically situated at the edge of the forest, only about five minutes from the village centre. With around 100 m² of living space, it combines Tyrolean cosiness with a high level of comfort. Parking spaces, a terrace and equipment for small children are available. The quiet edge-of-village location directly on the cross-country ski trail as well as at the ski, hiking and bus stop makes the accommodation a good starting point for active holidaymakers. The holiday home has four bedrooms, a balcony with a river view, a terrace with a mountain view, satellite flat-screen TV and a kitchen with a fridge, dishwasher and oven. A bathroom is equipped with a shower and hairdryer. The facilities also include a garden, a barbecue, free Wi-Fi, a shared kitchen and a shared lounge.

History/Background

Reliable information about the building history of the house is not handed down in the available sources. Ferienhaus Waldfrieden is run as a private holiday accommodation and is listed as a holiday flat or apartment in the accommodation directory of the East Tyrol Tourist Board and on tirol.de. In the Tourist Board's description it is presented as a child-friendly house with extensive equipment for small children. English and Italian are named as languages, and payment by invoice is possible.

Arrival

Kartitsch is located in East Tyrol in the Hochpustertal region. The accommodation is situated directly at the ski, hiking and bus stop, so arriving by public transport is easily possible; the entry point to the cross-country ski trail is right next to the house. Parking spaces are available for guests, according to the sources a free private parking space. The address is Kartitsch 157, 9941 Kartitsch. The accommodation is around 0.7 kilometres from the centre of Kartitsch.

Tips

According to the booking portal, check-in is possible from 16:00 to 19:30, and departure until 10:00. Bed linen and towels are not included in the price and can be rented on site for 12 euros per person; electricity costs are also billed separately according to consumption. Pets are welcome. The facilities include, among other things, a bread roll service, a ski storage room, a laundry service and garden furniture. Skiing opportunities are available in the surrounding area; the Winterwichtelland Sillian is around 11 kilometres away, and the Three Peaks Dolomites around 29 kilometres.

Best Travel Time

Since the cross-country ski trail and ski bus entry points are right next to the house, the accommodation is particularly suitable for a winter holiday; winter sports opportunities are available in the immediate surroundings. The warmer months are suitable for hikers and families, as the house is quietly located at the edge of the forest and on the edge of the village. None of the available sources names specific season dates, so current availability should be asked about directly with the host.
